objective: Promote one physical carrier from a Leech edge blueprint to a laboratory realization of the Moonshine VOA without substituting disconnected toys or fitted scalar traces for provenance.

carrierRule.required: Every gate B through I must be measured on the same carrier that passed gate A, with persistent operator identifiers and calibration records.
carrierRule.forbiddenSubstitution: Passing a gate on a separate XXZ chain, clock model, surface code, numerical VOA, or classical emulator does not advance the laboratory carrier.
carrierRule.resetCondition: Changing the Hilbert space, Hamiltonian phase, boundary termination, or defect implementation resets all downstream gates unless an experimentally verified isometry transports their observables.

gates.name: Leech chiral edge
gates.formalTarget: even unimodular rank-24 K matrix, c_minus=24 and trivial bulk anyon group
gates.measurement: verify on each spatial boundary 24 same-sign chiral modes, |c_minus|=24, f_current L/v=1, first lattice onset 2v/L, Casimir ratio -1 and the signed thermal Hall slope; also verify exactly 24 weight-one currents, no norm-two lattice roots, the Leech momentum Gram form, primitive Haldane-null bulk gapping and a periodic-closure control with no edge tower
gates.pass: one microscopic carrier realizes the rank-24 rootless Leech edge within declared finite-size and spectral tolerances, including the 196560 norm-four multiplicity and 196884 total weight-two count without fitting them

gates.name: crossed inversion enrichment
gates.formalTarget: P V_l P^-1 = V_-l rather than a factorized toric-code action
gates.measurement: process tomography of PTP^-1 against T^-1 plus a branch-cut-removed control
gates.pass: preregistered proposal: |W_enriched|<=0.1, |W_control-1|<=0.1 and their separation exceeds five standard errors
gates.failMeaning: factorized orbifold impostor or uncontrolled branch cut

gates.name: orbifold parent sectors
gates.formalTarget: four V_Lambda^+ sectors with Z2 squared fusion, spins (1,1,1,-1) and toric-code S matrix
gates.measurement: sector fusion, topological-spin and modular-interferometry tomography using the same inversion flux from B
gates.pass: all fusion products, four spins and sixteen S entries agree with the frozen toric-code record

gates.name: twisted m condensation and current removal
gates.formalTarget: select 1+m rather than 1+e, producing V-natural rather than V-Lambda
gates.measurement: condensation boundary tomography and the normalized thermal coefficient at weight one
gates.pass: m is transparent at the chosen boundary and the weight-one current count changes from 24 to 0 while c_minus remains 24
gates.failMeaning: Leech extension, incomplete condensation, or loss of the c=24 carrier

gates.name: Moonshine character and twisted split
gates.measurement: finite-size spectroscopy and sector-resolved thermal traces over at least three sizes and three aspect ratios
gates.pass: zero weight-one coefficient, convergent 196884 and 21493760 degeneracies, and the frozen untwisted/twisted weight-two split without fitting those values
gates.failMeaning: a different c=24 theory or an unresolved finite-size emulator

gates.name: 2A duality defect
gates.formalTarget: the Monster 2A duality line, its square-root-two condensation interface, and the norm-four Ising realization whose paired involutions multiply to the 2B grading
gates.measurement: defect fusion, junction recoupling and quantum-dimension scaling; resolve the Ising weights 0, 1/2 and 1/16 with multiplicities 47104, 2048 and 49152 on the twisted weight-two block; then compose the paired Miyamoto involutions on the same Moonshine edge
gates.pass: the measured defect algebra and held-out junction amplitude match the sourced 2A record, each paired involution has zero twisted-block trace, and their product is the already certified 2B sector sign rather than an independently fitted involution
gates.failMeaning: generic Ising interface without Monster defect provenance

gates.name: marked 23AB Tambara-Yamagami sector
gates.formalTarget: TY(Z23,chi,epsilon), chi(a,b)=exp(2 pi i ab/23), qdim(N)=sqrt(23)
gates.measurement: fusion and recoupling tomography with a physically marked order-23 generator
gates.pass: all entry magnitudes equal 1/sqrt(23), held-out plaquette phases equal exp[-2 pi i (a-a_prime)(b-b_prime)/23], F squared is charge conjugation, and the FS sign is recorded
gates.failMeaning: generic Z23 noninvertible symmetry or unmarked generator relabelling

gates.name: order-46 common-root junction
gates.formalTarget: one operator h with h squared in 23AB and h^23 in 2A or 2B
gates.measurement: power-map process tomography and connected thermal traces at y=0.8, 1.0 and 1.2
gates.pass: the same h passes both power maps and, at y=1, reproduces the frozen magnitudes 0.00373794542221053 for 46AB/2B and 0.0784643601781287 for 46CD/2A; y=0.8 and 1.2 are held out
gates.failMeaning: factorized Z23 and Z2 layers, a fitted one-point toy, or the wrong Monster class

gates.name: operator-algebra closure
gates.formalTarget: Griess product, a selected H2(R) Jordan corner and the Norton-Sakuma pair atlas
gates.measurement: six two-point plus ten symmetric three-point correlators for the corner; eight blind minimal-vector transitions targeting -7/8; anomaly-sensitive 1/8 oscillator response; followed by held-out Jordan and Ising-pair tests
gates.pass: the blind seed amplitudes, anomaly response and reconstructed product pass their frozen tolerances, the held-out Jordan identity, and untrained Norton-Sakuma pair types from overlap and involution-product order
gates.failMeaning: character-level agreement without the Monster operator algebra

promotion.claimAfterI: laboratory Monster realization at the tested operator-and-defect scope
